page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top left and centre, page number top right. Main text in one column, with marginal notes (Scripture references) in the right margin beside the upper text. Headings centred. Explicatio list of numbered items below, and a catchword-like signature "I. Quid" at lower right.

main_text.p: potius audiendus est Paulus, quàm latinus interpres. Nemo ignorat, μυστήριον Græcis non minus latè patere, quàm arcanum Latinis. Fateantur ergo Pontificij, omnia arcana esse sacramenta: atque coniugium erit sacramentum septimum: vocatio gentium erit nonum: & pietas decimum: & fortassis plura talia erunt numeranda. Nam omnibus hisce locis μυστήριον Latinus interpres transtulit sacramentum. Paulus verò mysterij nomine vtitur ad designandam Christi & ecclesiæ, non autem mariti & vxoris coniunctionem.Ephes. 1, 9.Ephes. 3, 3.1 Tim. 3, 16.Eph. 5, 32.
main_text.head: DE BAPTISMO.
QVÆSTIO LXIX.

p.i: Quaratione in Baptismo admoneris, & confirmaris, te vnici illius sacrificij Christi participem esse.

main_text.head: RESPONSIO.
main_text.p: Quod Christus externum aquæ lauacrũ mandauit a: addita hac promissione b, me non minus certo ipsius sanguine & Spiritu à sordibus animæ, hoc est, ab omnibus meis peccatis lauari: quam aqua extrinsecus ablutus sum c, qua sordes corporis expurgari solent.

p.i: a Matth. 28, 19. b Ib. Marci 16, 16. Act. 2, 38. Ioh. 1, 33. Matth. 13, 11. Rom. 6, 3.4. c 1 Pet. 3, 21. Marci 1, 4. Luc. 3, 3.

main_text.head: EXPLICATIO.
main_text.l: II. Qui sint fines baptismi, seu ad quid sit institutus.
V. Qua loquendi forma de baptismo.
VIII. Quomodo baptismus cum circumcisione conueniat, & quid ab ea differat.
main_text.p: Duæ priores quæstiones pertinent ad quæst. catechet. LXIX. tertia & quarta ad LXXI. quinta ad LXXI. LXXII. sexta ad LXXIII. septima & octaua explicantur in loco de circumcisione, quisequitur.

page.notes: The numbers beside the Explicatio list are Roman numerals I to VIII printed in the margin of the list. The Greek word μυστήριον is printed in Greek with a small mark above. Some lines in the upper text are faint and were read with care; the Latin pages are otherwise clear. The Explicatio lines are set in a separate indented style and are given as list lines.
